2607.21155.title: CRAG-MM-Diagnostics: Enabling Stage-Wise Analysis of Knowledge-Intensive VQA
2607.21155.paper_summary: Knowledge-Intensive Visual Question Answering (KI-VQA) benchmarks evaluate Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as multimodal knowledge assistants by requiring external information beyond a provided image to answer questions. KI-VQA involves multiple sub-problems -referring expression understanding, visual grounding, object recognition, knowledge retrieval, and reasoning-yet existing benchmarks typically report only end-task accuracy, obscuring where failures arise. To analyze the full KI-VQA pipeline, we introduce CRAG-MM-Diagnostics, a diagnostic benchmark with stage-wise data annotations that isolate 1) language-based visual grounding, 2) object identification, and 3) knowledge retrieval and reasoning. We evaluate fully parametric and retrieval-augmented VLMs, providing fine-grained analyses using newly collected metadata, such as target ROIs, entity names, and visual complexity scores. Our results point to knowledge retrieval and reasoning as the primary bottleneck, but also highlight issues in the other parts of the KI-VQA pipeline, such as the fact that VLMs struggle with target object identification or that image retrievers struggle to integrate textual cues. These findings expose fundamental limitations in current KI-VQA systems and motivate stage-aware evaluation. We, lastly, leverage these findings to propose a grounded bimodal RAG pipeline that integrates a visual grounding module to crop targets before image retrieval, boosting GPT-5 and Qwen's respective accuracies by 13.3 and 8.5 percentage points.
2607.21155.paper_summary_zh: 知識密集型視覺問題回答（KI-VQA）基準通過要求提供的圖像之外的外部信息來回答問題，評估視覺語言模型（VLM）作為多模態知識助手。KI-VQA 涉及多個子問題——指稱表達理解、視覺定位、物體識別、知識檢索和推理——但現有基準通常僅報告最終任務的準確性，掩蓋了失敗的根源。為了分析完整的 KI-VQA 流程，我們引入了 CRAG-MM-Diagnostics，一個具有階段性數據註釋的診斷基準，將 1) 基於語言的視覺定位、2) 物體識別和 3) 知識檢索與推理進行隔離。我們評估了完全參數化和檢索增強的 VLM，並使用新收集的元數據（如目標 ROI、實體名稱和視覺複雜性分數）提供細緻的分析。我們的結果指出知識檢索和推理是主要瓶頸，但也突顯了 KI-VQA 流程中其他部分的問題，例如 VLM 在目標物體識別方面的困難或圖像檢索器在整合文本提示方面的挑戰。這些發現揭示了當前 KI-VQA 系統的基本局限性，並促使階段意識評估。最後，我們利用這些發現提出了一個基於視覺定位模塊的雙模態 RAG 流程，以在圖像檢索之前裁剪目標，分別提高 GPT-5 和 Qwen 的準確率 13.3 和 8.5 個百分點。
